risk_summary: The excerpt presents a mixed risk profile: COVID-19 caused a 29% annual sales decline, pressured end markets, and required cost and production reductions, although liquidity and recovery trends are described positively. Extensive non-GAAP discussion and the inability to reconcile forward-looking measures may limit comparability and obscure the potential impact of unusual items. Credit risk appears manageable based on stated $1.1 billion of available liquidity, but remains exposed to economic recovery, customer collections, inventory, and used-equipment market conditions.
